# Programs GSEA {.tabset}


```{r fig.height=11, fig.width=13}
library(hypeR)
library(ggpubr)
plotlist = list()
for (i in 1:5) {
  print(paste("program",i,"out of",ncol(gep_scores)))
  ranked_vec = gep_scores %>% pull(i) %>%  setNames(rownames(gep_scores))
  hyp_obj <-hypeR_fgsea(signature = ranked_vec,genesets = geneIds(genesets),up_only = T)
  if(!any(hyp_obj$data$fdr<0.2)){ #if no significant values, print to closest one
    plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj, merge = F, fdr = min(hyp_obj$data$fdr)) + aes(size = nes) + ggtitle(paste("program", i)) +
      guides(size = guide_legend(title = "NES", reverse = T)) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(1, 2)))
    
  }else{
    plt = hyp_dots(hyp_obj, merge = F, fdr = 0.2) + aes(size = nes) + ggtitle(paste("program", i)) +
      guides(size = guide_legend(title = "NES", reverse = T)) +
      scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(1, 2)))
  }

  plotlist[[i]] = plt
}


plotlist = lapply(plotlist,FUN = function(x) { #fix cropped edges
  x = x +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0.1,1,0.1,0.01, "cm")) 
})

plotlist = lapply(plotlist,FUN = function(x) { #fix axis ticks
  x = x + scale_y_continuous(trans = hypeR:::.reverselog_trans(10), 
        breaks =exp(-seq(-log(min(x$data$fdr)), -log(max(x$data$fdr)), 
            length.out = 6)) %>% signif(digits = 2))
})



p = ggarrange(plotlist = plotlist,common.legend = T,nrow = 3,ncol = 2)
p


svg(filename = params$data_out_dir %s+% "cNMF_programs_GSEA.svg",height = 11,width = 13)
p
dev.off()
```

# calculate cell usage by TPM and not harmony adjusted

```{r}
# get the top 2000 vargenes data
xeno = FindVariableFeatures(object = xeno,nfeatures = 2000)
xeno_vargenes = VariableFeatures(object = xeno)

xeno_expression = FetchData(object = xeno,vars = xeno_vargenes,slot='counts')
all_0_genes = colnames(xeno_expression)[colSums(xeno_expression==0, na.rm=TRUE)==nrow(xeno_expression)] #delete rows that have all 0
xeno_vargenes = xeno_vargenes[!xeno_vargenes %in% all_0_genes]

```




```{python}
import numpy as np
import scanpy as sc
xeno_expression = r.xeno_expression
xeno_vargenes = r.xeno_vargenes
tpm =  compute_tpm(xeno_expression)
usage_by_calc = get_usage_from_score(counts=xeno_expression,tpm=tpm,genes=xeno_vargenes, cnmf_obj=cnmf_obj,k=k)
```


```{r}
all_metagenes = py$usage_by_calc
```
